title: Jil Theo's Life Advice
subtitle: Fifty-five hard-won lessons on control, money, discipline, and time.
subtitleZh: 五十五条经验之谈，关于掌控、金钱、自律与时间。
author: Jil Theo
description: A fifty-five-year-old's list of what actually matters: the only thing you control, the cost of comfort, and why nobody is coming to save you.
descriptionZh: 一位五十五岁的人写下真正重要的东西：你唯一能掌控的事、舒适的代价，以及为什么没有人会来救你。

paragraphs.en: 1. At 55, I've learned this: the only thing you truly control is your response to what happens in your life. And that's enough to change everything.
paragraphs.zh: 1. 在55岁的时候，我明白了这一点：你真正能够掌控的只有你对生活中发生的事情的反应。而这一点就足以改变一切。

paragraphs.en: 2. Working on yourself is the best investment you can make. The returns last a lifetime.
paragraphs.zh: 2. 提升自己是最值得的投资。这种回报会持续一生。

paragraphs.en: 3. Taking 100% responsibility for everything that happens to you is what will save your life. Complaining changes nothing.
paragraphs.zh: 3. 承担起发生在你身上的一切事情的全部责任，这才是真正能救你的东西。抱怨没有任何作用。

paragraphs.en: 4. Personal development is the only way to grow. No one else can do it for you.
paragraphs.zh: 4. 个人成长是自我提升的唯一途径。没有其他人能够替你做到这一点。

paragraphs.en: 5. The sooner you educate yourself financially, the sooner you'll be financially free. No one gets rich by accident.
paragraphs.zh: 5. 你越早了解财务知识，就越能早日实现财务自由。没有人能够偶然致富的。

paragraphs.en: 6. Learn to take risks. Don't learn to avoid them. Playing it safe keeps you small.
paragraphs.zh: 6. 学会勇于冒险。不要试图避免风险。谨慎行事只会让你变得渺小。

paragraphs.en: 7. If you think making money is hard, try poverty. That's real pain.
paragraphs.zh: 7. 如果你认为赚钱很困难，那就试试生活在贫困之中吧。那才是真正的痛苦。

paragraphs.en: 8. Step out of the consumption patterns you grew up in, as soon as possible: fast food, fast fashion, fast scrolling. It may seem easy now, but it will cost you more later.
paragraphs.zh: 8. 尽快跳出你从小养成的消费模式：快餐、快时尚、无脑刷屏。现在看似轻松，日后代价更大。

paragraphs.en: 9. Don't chase after people. Be so strong, smart, and charismatic that people chase after you.
paragraphs.zh: 9. 不要追逐别人。要变得强大、聪明且富有魅力，这样人们才会追随着你。

paragraphs.en: 10. Just because you haven't reached your life goal by 30 doesn't mean you won't by 50. It's never too late to succeed in life.
paragraphs.zh: 10. 仅仅因为你到30岁时还没有实现自己的人生目标，并不意味着你在50岁时也无法实现目标。成功永远都不晚。

paragraphs.en: 11. Waking up on a Monday morning without even realizing it's Monday is a luxury. Trust me.
paragraphs.zh: 11. 在周一的早晨醒来，却完全没有意识到今天是周一，这是一种奢侈。相信我吧。

paragraphs.en: 12. You'll have a job, a boss, and colleagues. There will be times to appreciate them and times to hate them. That's life.
paragraphs.zh: 12. 你会有一份工作、一位上司以及一群同事。有时候你会感激他们，有时候则会讨厌他们。这就是生活。

paragraphs.en: 13. The simplest way to succeed in life is by delaying gratification. Shortcuts will trip you up in the end.
paragraphs.zh: 13. 在人生中取得成功的最简单方法就是延迟满足感。走捷径最终会让你陷入困境。

paragraphs.en: 14. Don't take it personal, but in their 20's, 100% of people think they are 100% right. But they're not.
paragraphs.zh: 14. 请不要往心里去，因为在他们二十多岁的时候，所有人都会认为自己完全正确。但实际上并非如此。

paragraphs.en: 15. Don't let 15 minutes of a bad mood ruin your day. One bad moment isn't worth 24 bad hours.
paragraphs.zh: 15. 不要让15分钟的负面情绪毁掉你的一天。一个糟糕的时刻并不值得换取24小时的不愉快时光。

paragraphs.en: 16. Always be kind to the people you meet. You don't know what they've been through.
paragraphs.zh: 16. 永远要对遇到的人友善对待。你不知道他们经历了什么。

paragraphs.en: 17. If one day you think you're lost, you're probably not. You're sometimes just addicted to comfort.
paragraphs.zh: 17. 如果有一天你觉得自己迷失了方向，你很可能并没有。你只是有时候对舒适上了瘾。

paragraphs.en: 18. Your true wealth won't be in becoming rich but in the freedom to do what you want, when you want, where you want.
paragraphs.zh: 18. 你真正的财富不在于变得富有，而在于拥有自由：做你想做的事，在你想的时候、你想的地方。

paragraphs.en: 19. The skills that got you here won't get you there. Keep learning.
paragraphs.zh: 19. 让你走到今天这一步的技能，并不能保证你继续前进。继续学习吧。

paragraphs.en: 20. Your parents did their best with what they knew. Forgive them for what they didn't teach you and teach yourself now.
paragraphs.zh: 20. 你的父母用他们知道的全部尽了最大努力。原谅他们没能教给你的东西，现在就自己去学。

paragraphs.en: 21. If you feel behind, remember: Love, family, money, growth. All is possible at any age.
paragraphs.zh: 21. 如果你觉得自己落后了，记住：爱、家庭、金钱、成长——任何年纪都还来得及。

paragraphs.en: 22. The habits you build in your 20s and 30s determine the quality of life you'll have in your 50s and 60s.
paragraphs.zh: 22. 你在20岁和30岁时所养成的习惯，将决定你在50岁和60岁时的生活质量。

paragraphs.en: 23. Being busy and being productive are not the same thing. Learn this as soon as possible before anyone leads you to confuse the two.
paragraphs.zh: 23. 忙碌和富有成效并不是一回事。在别人误导你之前，尽快明白这一点吧。

paragraphs.en: 24. Your parents will be the only ones to love you unconditionally. You'll learn this through harsh disappointments.
paragraphs.zh: 24. 你的父母将是唯一能无条件爱你的人。你会通过那些痛苦的失望经历来领悟这一道理的。

paragraphs.en: 25. Money can't buy happiness. But poverty can't buy anything.
paragraphs.zh: 25. 金钱无法买到幸福。但贫穷则根本买不到任何东西。

paragraphs.en: 26. Never forget: you will spend decades working for someone who can replace you in a day.
paragraphs.zh: 26. 永远记住：你将需要花费数十年时间，为那些能在一天之内取代你的人工作。

paragraphs.en: 27. Your kids won't remember the extra hours you worked to buy them things. They'll remember your absence at dinner.
paragraphs.zh: 27. 你的孩子不会记得你为了给他们买东西而付出的那些辛勤劳动时间。他们只会记得你晚餐时不在家的情况。

paragraphs.en: 28. The average person checks their phone 144 times a day. That's 144 decisions to stay distracted instead of building something.
paragraphs.zh: 28. 普通人每天查看手机 144 次。那是 144 次让自己保持分心、而不是去建造点什么的选择。

paragraphs.en: 29. Your health is the only asset you can't rebuild with money once it's gone. Ask anyone fighting a disease if they'd trade wealth for wellness.
paragraphs.zh: 29. 你的健康是那件一旦失去就无法用金钱重新获得的东西。随便问一个正在与疾病斗争的人，他们是否会用财富来换取健康。

paragraphs.en: 30. Your kids don't need you to be perfect. They need you to be present. And presence requires energy you don't have when you're running on empty.
paragraphs.zh: 30. 你的孩子不需要你做到完美无缺。他们只需要你陪在身边。而陪伴需要精力——当你自己已经耗尽时，这份精力你是拿不出来的。

paragraphs.en: 31. Love doesn't pay bills, but financial stress kills love faster than anything else. Money matters in relationships. Period.
paragraphs.zh: 31. 爱情不会支付账单，但财务压力却比其他任何事情都更快地摧毁爱情。在恋爱关系中，金钱是非常重要的因素。就是这样。

paragraphs.en: 32. You're not tired from working too hard. You're drained from working on things that don't matter to the life you're trying to build.
paragraphs.zh: 32. 你并非因为工作过度而感到疲惫。你之所以疲惫，是因为在从事那些对你想要建立的生活毫无意义的事情上付出努力所致。

paragraphs.en: 33. Your mindset will be the first thing to fix in your life. The money will follow. Not the other way around.
paragraphs.zh: 33. 你的心态是首先需要改善的方面。金钱自然会随之而来，而不是相反。

paragraphs.en: 34. If you're still in your 20's, learn this: 30 is not old. 40 is not old. 50 is not old. It's never too late to succeed in life.
paragraphs.zh: 34. 如果你还在二十多岁的年纪，那么请记住：30岁并不算老；40岁也不算老；50岁同样也不算老。无论年龄多大，成功的机会永远都存在。

paragraphs.en: 35. You have every right to distance yourself from those who constantly take your time, energy, and peace. No is a full sentence. The rest is none of your business.
paragraphs.zh: 35. 你完全有权利远离那些总是占用你的时间、精力以及安宁的人。拒绝就是拒绝，无需多言。其余的事情都与你无关。

paragraphs.en: 36. Life isn't always fair. Sometimes you lose friends, sometimes you miss chances, and sometimes you face unfair setbacks.
paragraphs.zh: 36. 生活并不总是公平的。有时候你会失去朋友，有时候你会错过机会，还有时候你会面临一些不公平的挫折。

paragraphs.en: 37. People won't tell you this, but they're waiting for you to fail.
paragraphs.zh: 37. 人们不会主动告诉你这一点，但他们其实在等着你失败。

paragraphs.en: 38. Your life is nothing more than your perception of the events you face through the lens of your own experiences, personal beliefs, and habits formed over time. The sooner you understand this, the more likely you are to live a full life.
paragraphs.zh: 38. 你的生活本质上只是你通过自己的经历、个人信念以及长期形成的习惯来感知所面对的各种事件的反映。你越能理解这一点，就越有可能过上充实的生活。

paragraphs.en: 39. Your confidence will become 10 times more powerful when you take action.
paragraphs.zh: 39. 当你采取行动时，你的信心将会增强10倍。

paragraphs.en: 40. Most people will never admit it, but the most important skills aren't taught in school.
paragraphs.zh: 40. 大多数人永远不会承认这一点，但实际上，最重要的技能并不是在学校里被教授的。

paragraphs.en: 41. More particularly, you won't hear this in school: "The rich buy assets. The poor buy status."
paragraphs.zh: 41. 更具体地说，你在学校里是不会听到这样的说法的：“富人购买资产，而穷人则追求社会地位。”

paragraphs.en: 42. The Lambo some kid is showing off on Instagram isn't luxury. Having your health, your parents close by, and a family that supports your goals is. You'll understand this sooner or later.
paragraphs.zh: 42. 那些在 Instagram 上炫耀兰博基尼的小孩所展示的，根本算不上真正的奢侈。真正奢侈的是拥有健康的身体、离你不远的父母，以及支持你目标的家庭。你迟早会明白这一点。

paragraphs.en: 43. In 2026, relying on a single stream of income is obsolete.
paragraphs.zh: 43. 到2026年，依赖单一收入来源已经不再可行了。

paragraphs.en: 44. Universal rule: You can't save others if you haven't saved yourself.
paragraphs.zh: 44. 通用规则：如果你没有先拯救自己，那么你就无法拯救他人。

paragraphs.en: 45. People will naturally think poorly of you before they think well of you. It's human nature. It's your job to make the best first impression of yourself.
paragraphs.zh: 45. 人们往往会先看低你，之后才会看到你的好。这是人性。你的任务，是让人对你的第一印象尽可能好。

paragraphs.en: 46. Your long-term wealth will depend much more on your life partner than on your ability to make money.
paragraphs.zh: 46. 你的长期财富更多地取决于你的伴侣，而不是你赚钱的能力。

paragraphs.en: 47. You say you'll start. Then you don't. Fix that problem first.
paragraphs.zh: 47. 你声称会开始行动，但实际上并没有这么做。先解决那个问题吧。

paragraphs.en: 48. Most people will never admit how much their own beliefs are holding them back. Don't be like most people.
paragraphs.zh: 48. 大多数人永远都不会承认自己的信念是如何阻碍他们的成长的。不要像大多数人一样。

paragraphs.en: 49. Don't forget: the best is yet to come. Always.
paragraphs.zh: 49. 别忘了：最好的事情还在后面。永远如此。

paragraphs.en: 50. You will never have as many problems as when you have money problems. Breaking your beliefs about money will save you a lot of trouble.
paragraphs.zh: 50. 你永远不会像有金钱问题的时候那样面临如此多的麻烦。打破你对金钱的执念，就能为你省去很多麻烦。

paragraphs.en: 51. If you're broke, your #1 job is to sell something. Starting with you.
paragraphs.zh: 51. 如果你身无分文，那么你的首要任务就是出售一些东西。从你自己开始吧。

paragraphs.en: 52. The only thing holding you back: you think you need more time, more money, more chance. You don't. You need more courage to start and more discipline to keep going.
paragraphs.zh: 52. 阻碍你的唯一因素就是：你以为自己需要更多的时间、更多的金钱、更多的机会。但实际上你并不需要这些。你需要的是更多的勇气去开始，以及更多的自律来持续前进。

paragraphs.en: 53. Discipline is rare. If you wake up early, stay consistent, and don't quit, you're already top 10%.
paragraphs.zh: 53. 自律是非常罕见的。如果你能早起，保持持续的努力，并且不放弃，那么你肯定属于最优秀的10%之中。

paragraphs.en: 54. Nobody is coming to save you. Not your parents. Not your boss. Not your friends. It's your life. Act like it.
paragraphs.zh: 54. 没有人会来救你。你的父母不会，你的老板也不会，你的朋友们同样不会。这是你的生活。所以就要像对待自己的生命一样来对待它。

paragraphs.en: 55. Stop treating your life like you have unlimited time. Every day you postpone is another day closer to wishing you'd started today.
paragraphs.zh: 55. 别再把生活当成时间无限。你每推迟一天，就离“真希望自己今天就开始了”更近一天。
